name: JotDrop
description: All your notes as Google Keep-style cards: pin, color, drag into your own order, tick checklists, set reminders, archive, and take a quick note. No account needed. Optional: bring in notes from the JotDrop app through JotDrop Cloud.
author: Diexar Labs
